_meta.description: Rate-limiting config change for prod with blast radius across all API endpoints — no test evidence
_meta.teaching_point: A 'small' config change that affects every API endpoint is blocked. The surface footprint (1 YAML file) does not reflect the operational blast radius. The gate fires on missing evidence for prod.

change_package.title: Tighten prod rate limits: reduce global cap from 1000 to 200 req/min
change_package.diff_text:
--- a/config/rate_limits_prod.yaml
+++ b/config/rate_limits_prod.yaml
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 global:
-  requests_per_minute: 1000
+  requests_per_minute: 200
   burst_allowance: 50
   action: throttle
change_package.author_summary: Reducing the global rate limit to align with capacity planning results from last week's load test. The 1000 rpm cap was causing cascading timeouts under burst traffic. New cap: 200 rpm with 50-burst allowance.
change_package.rollback_plan: Revert config/rate_limits_prod.yaml to previous value. Takes effect on next config reload (no redeploy needed).
